verdict.rationale: Folk's integrations page claims Gmail conversation sync and automatic import of conversations and contacts, so the core Gmail email-sync capability is its own documented feature. The evidence is only a pair of one-line marketing claims, with nothing on Outlook, sync direction, or how emails are matched to records. missing for 10: Outlook support, evidence of two-way sync, documentation of automatic logging/matching of emails to the correct person/company/deal records, in-depth docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.
